claim_definition: Verifies that the append-only SHA-256 Merkle transparency log correctly issues and validates inclusion proofs for anchored evidence entries. Any third party holding the log root and an inclusion proof can independently verify that a specific evidence record was committed to the log, without trusting the operator. A forged or non-existent entry cannot produce a valid inclusion proof.
scope: SCITT-compatible append-only Merkle log; evidence anchor; TRACE registry integration
excluded_scope: Log compaction and archival; signed tree head (STH) timestamp verification; cross-log consistency proofs

test_cases.description: Verifies that entry-B (a real committed evidence anchor) produces a valid Merkle inclusion proof against the 4-entry log root. Any party can recompute this proof independently.
A forged entry not present in the log cannot produce a valid inclusion proof. The verifier rejects it, confirming the log's tamper-evidence property.
